_comment: Copy to config.json (or set ARTEX_CONFIG to another path). This file contains only database and skill_dir; configure LLM and other settings through environment variables or in the application.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose either (A) the individual fields below or (B) a complete connection string in database.dsn only.
_comment_database_dsn: Option (B): replace database above with a complete DSN. A nonempty dsn overrides individual fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, containing SKILL.md). Precedence: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ beside the executable). Leave blank or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths resolve from the current working directory.
